title: Storage template form
purpose: Record a unit layout as a template, add a new version, or change an existing version.
summary: Record a unit layout as a template, add a new version, or change an existing version.

tasks.title: Record a layout
steps: Type the [[Code]] and [[Name]], and the [[Layout recipe]].
Select [[Create storage template]]. Errors name the part of the recipe at fault.

tasks.title: Start from an existing unit
steps: Use Save layout as template on the unit's page. The recipe is filled in for you.

good_to_know: An existing code adds the next version.
The recipe is plain data, checked against the same rules as creating units directly.
Once a unit is created from a version, its recipe is no longer offered for editing.

sections.title: Fields
paragraphs: Only the admin and manager roles can open or submit this form.

Entering a code that already exists adds the next version. Once a unit has been created from a version its layout is fixed: the Layout recipe is then not offered, so add a new version to change it. Opened from a unit's Save layout as template, the recipe is pre-filled from that unit; opened from New version, from the earlier version.

items.label: Code
items.description: Create only. Up to 40 letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-', starting with a letter or digit. Stored in capitals. It can never be changed or reused, even after retirement. An existing code adds a new version.

items.label: Active
items.description: Edit only. Inactive templates cannot be applied.

items.label: Layout recipe
items.description: Required JSON, described in the next section. The recipe is checked against the same rules as direct creation and saved in normalized form; an error names the node or box at fault.

items.label: Reason for the change
items.description: Edit only. Required, up to 2000 characters. Kept in the history.

sections.title: Layout recipe
paragraphs: The recipe is plain data, not a script. Unknown keys are rejected. Limits: at most 400 nodes, 400 boxes and 40,000 positions, and 4 levels. Codes in a recipe are suffixes; applying the template puts the new unit's code and a hyphen before each (VP-02 and T01 become VP-02-T01).

items.label: storage_class
items.description: Required; the code of an existing storage class.

items.label: technology
items.description: Required; one of ln2_vapor, ln2_liquid, mechanical, ambient.

items.label: nominal_temperature
items.description: Required; a quoted decimal such as "-160.00" from -273.15 to 9999.99 with at most two decimal places. A stated set point, not a measurement.

items.label: nodes
items.description: Required, non-empty list of top-level nodes.

items.label: node: suffix, name, kind
items.description: suffix is required, 1 to 30 letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-', and unique across all nodes and boxes of the recipe. name is optional, up to 160 characters. kind is shelf, rack, tower or canister; a shelf holds racks, the others hold shelves.

items.label: node: slot
items.description: Required whole number from 1 (up to the parent's child_slots, or 100 at the top level); not used twice in the same place.

items.label: node: child_slots, box_slots
items.description: Whole numbers 0 to 100; exactly one must be above 0. A node with child_slots lists children and no boxes; one with box_slots lists boxes and no children.

items.label: node: children, boxes
items.description: Lists of nodes and of boxes. A box has suffix, optional name, slot (1 to box_slots, unused) and container_type.

items.label: box: container_type
items.description: An object with code and version, naming an existing container type version. It must also be active when the template is applied.

sections.title: Saving
paragraphs: Editing needs a reason (up to 2000 characters), which is kept in the history with the values before and after. Creating records the setup without asking for a reason. If the record changed since you opened the form, the save is refused with a message to reload; your entries stay on the page, but check the current values before saving again. A save with nothing changed is refused.

items.label: Create storage template / Save changes
items.description: Saves and opens the template version.
